annotation.title_clean: From Human to Robot Interactions: A Circular Approach towards Trustworthy Social Robots
annotation.title_en: From Human to Robot Interactions: A Circular Approach towards Trustworthy Social Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Lange, A.L.; Kirtay, M.; Hafner, V.V.
annotation.summary_en: Short conceptual research paper proposing a circular approach to trust research in human-robot interaction: derive findings from human trust studies, test them on robots, build robotic trust frameworks, run reciprocal trust studies, and feed insights back into human studies. It has no direct governance or regulatory content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Distinguishes human trust in robots, robot trust in humans, and reciprocal human-robot trust.
Proposes a five-step circular workflow linking human trust studies and HRI.
Reciprocal trust is under-researched and could improve social robots.
Robots' manipulability allows controlled long-term trust experiments.
Safety and transparency are noted as key factors for trust in robots.
